sfc_structure.component: root — the SFC file; emits a Class symbol (isSvelteComponent/isSfc)
sfc_structure.template_element: markup — component usages -> instantiates; on: directives -> calls; {#if}/{#each}/{#await} -> template decision points
sfc_structure.script_element: script block — delegated to the JS/TS sub-analyzer (engine-provided sfcScriptTrees); multiple blocks allowed (module + instance)

template.element/self_closing_tag: instantiates (non-builtin tag, isComponentUsage) — leaf tag name as written
template.attribute: on: directive -> calls (handler leaf); prop bindings and interpolations carry template expressions -> member Uses (scope-aware)
template.expression: {{ expr }} — opaque svelte_raw_text; template member read -> Uses (scope-aware)
template.each_statement: loop decision point (complexity); collection expr -> member Uses; loop vars are template-local and shadow same-named members (S5 collision-gated)
template.await_statement: async decision point (complexity); promise expr -> member Uses; then/catch vars are template-local (shadow)
template.snippet_statement: component-owned Method symbol (isSnippet); snippet params are template-local
template.html_tag/const_tag/debug_tag: template expressions -> member Uses; {@const} binding is block-local and declaration-order-aware (S5)

script.export let: Property symbol (component prop API) via the JS export-let reclassification
script.$props(): Property symbols from destructure (isSvelteProp/fromRunes), exactly once; JS sub-analyzer duplicate is dropped (S2)
script.$: target = expr: reactive declaration -> one component-owned Variable symbol (isReactiveDeclaration), deduplicated across repeated targets (S6)
script.svelte runes: $state/$derived/$effect/$props — compiler macros; the initialized vars are symbols, the rune CALLS are filtered

expressions_requiring_uses_or_calls: {{ count }} / {expr} interpolation — template member use (gap S1)
attribute bindings label={label} this={Comp} — template member use (gap S1)
{#each items as item} collection — template member use; loop vars shadow same-named members (S5)
{#await promise then value} — template member use; then/catch vars shadow same-named members
{@html raw} / {@const x = expr} / {@debug expr} — template member use; const binding is local to its block
on: event directives -> calls (WORKS; handler leaf)
script expressions — delegated to JS/TS analyzer
S5/S6 hardening — each/await/snippet/const lexical scopes and repeated `$:` targets are permanently fixture- and mutant-gated
_notes: Svelte SFC = template + script + style; the script is parsed by the JS/TS sub-analyzer, so script-side edges (imports/calls/uses/references/contains/exports/extends/overrides) follow those analyzers.
The svelte grammar exposes template expressions as opaque svelte_raw_text (no child AST) — identifier extraction is by text scan, the documented fallback.
Component usages in template are instantiates (usage_contextual); HTML + Svelte builtin tags filtered.
The component symbol (file module name) is the SFC's Class; export-let/exported bindings and $props()/reactive declarations are component-owned.
